english.title: Use vehicle on part of Manchester Airport in contravention of steering, braking etc requirements
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[used a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[caused or permitted a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_

on part of Manchester Airport to which the road traffic enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART OF MANCHESTER AIRPORT..), which failed to comply with the braking, steering, lighting, tyre or electrical requirements which would apply to that vehicle if it were to be operated on a road to which the road traffic enactments did apply in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2.2 and 5.4 of the Manchester Airport Byelaws 2024.
